svg.aria-label: Walkthrough of Per-seat billing replaces metered credits, in six steps
svg.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "Noto Sans", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: Seat admission replaces metered draw credits
Private pull requests now check seats or trial status instead of consuming monthly credit counters.
New developers now expand seat count in Stripe
When all seats are in use and mode is automatic, PR Lens increments subscription quantity with prorations.
Plan selection page added before checkout
Users now choose between Essentials and Team with a starting seat count rather than subscribing to metered credits.
Seat management and approver controls added
Approvers can now adjust seats, change expansion modes, assign approvers, or free inactive seats.
Monthly spending caps and per-credit charges are deleted in favour of fixed seat counts.
The new seat admission and tracking services, plan selection flows, and comment updates in one picture.
